title: Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack PL
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.

Demais localidades: Remoto

Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview

You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Quem você é:

Você estabelece metas desafiadoras e mantém padrões elevados. Você é decisivo e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo quando baseadas em informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você atua como um parceiro estratégico para construir, desenvolver e manter relacionamentos lucrativos e duradouros com contas-chave.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Graduação em Engenharia (preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica, Automação, Instrumentação ou Mecânica);
  • MBA em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing altamente recomendado;
  • 7 a 10 anos de experiência em vendas técnicas, desenvolvimento de negócios ou gestão de contas estratégicas no mercado de óleo e gás;
  • Experiência comprovada em crescimento de mercado, negociação complexa e gestão de pipeline, preferencialmente no mercado de óleo e gás;
  • Português fluente e Inglês avançado (para leitura de manuais, treinamentos e comunicação com matriz);

  • Forte capacidade analítica e estratégica.
  • Disponibilidade para embarques em plataformas de petróleo para:
  • Inspeção visual de instalações e equipamentos;
  • Suporte a técnicos de serviços durante atividades críticas;
  • Geração de demanda de vendas por meio da execução de walkdowns e identificação de oportunidades.
  • Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro-RJ.


Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. title: Analista de Governança Microsoft Pleno | Senior
description:
Analista de Governança Microsoft - Pleno / Sênior 

Missão

Atuar como referência de governança e sustentação técnica (nível N3) para o ecossistema Microsoft, garantindo estabilidade, segurança, conformidade e controle de custos principalmente em Power Platform, SharePoint Online e Copilot Studio. A posição combina administração de plataforma com capacidade prática de construção e troubleshooting de soluções low-code e agentes.

A administração e governança desses produtos é centralizada nos centros de administração (Power Platform Admin Center etc.) e envolve proteger dados, controlar acessos e monitorar o que makers/usuários fazem.

Escopo de atuação

Microsoft (Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, M365/Entra, Copilot Studio)

Administração pontual / governança leve de plataformas de IA corporativa (Gemini Enterprise, OpenAI Enterprise, NotebookLM) (ex.: gestão de acessos, onboarding, padrões e controles básicos)

Requisitos

1) Administração e Sustentação da Plataforma (N3)

Administrar ambientes (criação, padronização, saneamento, controle de capacidade e permissões), garantindo operação estável e previsível.

Executar rotinas de manutenção, saneamento e ajustes técnicos (ex.: ambientes órfãos, owners, conectores, políticas, agentes e automações fora de padrão).

Definir e manter runbooks e procedimentos operacionais para incidentes recorrentes e auditorias.

2) Governança e Segurança (Power Platform + Copilot Studio + M365)

Implementar e operar políticas de governança: DLP, segmentação de conectores (Business/Non-Business), padrões de ambientes e critérios de publicação.

Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade).

3) Desenvolvimento e Troubleshooting (N3 Maker) — obrigatório

Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em:Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança).

Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model-driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas).

Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM).

4) Administração do Dataverse (capacidade, saúde e KPIs)

Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário).

Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.).

Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao CoE e relatórios operacionais.

5) Gestão de custos e sustentabilidade financeira

Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de:Power Apps / Power Automate

Copilot Studio (agentes)

Propor medidas de otimização (racionalização de ambientes, consolidação/arquivamento, revisão de owners/licenças, desativação de ativos sem uso, melhoria de governança de conectores)

6) Operação do CoE (Power Platform + Copilot Studio)

Administrar e evoluir o Centro de Excelência (CoE): inventário, auditoria operacional, padrões, dashboards e rotinas automatizadas de governança.

Monitorar automações administrativas do CoE e garantirexecução/observabilidade.

Suportar a organização com orientações de governança e boas práticas (makers, owners, champions e times low-code).

7) SharePoint Online (governança e sustentação)

Atuar em governança de SharePoint Online (estrutura, acessos, padrões de armazenamento, higiene/organização e integração com soluções Power Platform/Copilot)

Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência prática com administração e governança do Power Platform (ambientes, DLP, conectores, capacidade, troubleshooting).

Conhecimento sólido de licenciamento e segurança no ecossistema Power Platform + M365.

Capacidade de desenvolver:Agentes no Copilot Studio (incluindo conectores/ações e governança)

Power Apps e Power Automate (para ser N3 de desenvolvimento e plataforma)

Vivência com Dataverse (administração, organização e sustentação operacional).

Experiência com SharePoint Online (admin/governança básica a intermediária e integrações).

Diferenciais (nice to have)

Experiência com CoE Starter Kit e práticas de adoção/governança em escala.

Conhecimento de logs/auditoria (Purview/Sentinel) aplicados a Copilot Studio e governança.

Noções de ALM / padrões / RACI para governança e operação de plataformas low-code.

Vivência com governança básica/gestão de acessos em Gemini Enterprise / OpenAI Enterprise / NotebookLM (menor demanda).

title: Customer Support & Operations Specialist
description:

title: Oficial Operacional Geral
description:
Oficial Operacional Geral (Manutenção & Multitarefas)


Procuramos um Oficial Operacional Geral (Manutenção & Multitarefas) para integrar nossa equipe de administração de imóveis por temporada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ. Se você é proativo, tem múltiplas habilidades em manutenção e busca uma oportunidade dinâmica, essa vaga é para você!


Sobre a Vaga


Sua missão será garantir que nossos imóveis estejam sempre em perfeitas condições para os hóspedes. A rotina envolverá manutenções preventivas e corretivas em diversos apartamentos, além de atendimentos emergenciais que exigem agilidade e foco na solução.


O que você vai fazer:


Realizar manutenção geral e reparos, incluindo mas não se limitando:


•  Trocar lâmpadas, chuveiros, torneiras, sifões de pia, tomadas e interruptores simples, e outras atividades relacionadas.

•  Montar móveis de pequeno porte seguindo manual (ex: cama box, mesa, cadeira, cômoda, criado-mudo, estantes), e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Utilizar ferramentas manuais e elétricas leves de forma segura, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Realizar acompanhamento de serviços de terceiros.


•  Estar presente nos apartamentos durante montagens, instalações ou manutenções feitas por empresas contratadas, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Abrir e fechar o imóvel, liberar o acesso e acompanhar a execução dos serviços, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Reportar à equipe qualquer problema, atraso ou necessidade observada durante o acompanhamento, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Realizar vistorias preventivas (sob escala definida).


•  Verificar funcionamento de iluminação, tomadas e interruptores, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Checar funcionamento de ar-condicionado, TVs, Wi-Fi e eletrodomésticos, e outras atividades relacionadas.

•  Avaliar portas, trincos, fechaduras mecânicas e digitais, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Identificar sinais de desgaste, manutenção pendente ou problemas em geral e informar à equipe, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Manter comunicação constante com a equipe.


•  Utilizar aplicativos para celular para enviar fotos, registros e atualizações sobre cada atendimento ou vistoria, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Reportar com clareza problemas detectados durante as atividades, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Manter postura profissional e comunicação objetiva, e outras atividades relacionadas.


As atividades que listamos aqui são as principais, mas o trabalho pode ter outras coisas parecidas que apareçam no dia a dia.


O que Buscamos em Você


•  Experiência comprovada em manutenção geral, com habilidades diversas (elétrica, hidráulica, pintura, pequenos reparos).


•  Capacidade de organização e planejamento para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.


•  Proatividade na identificação de problemas e busca de soluções antes que se tornem urgências.


•  Olhar atento aos detalhes para identificar pequenas falhas e realizar acabamentos impecáveis.


•  Bom raciocínio lógico para diagnosticar problemas complexos e encontrar as melhores soluções.


•  Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão em situações emergenciais, mantendo a calma e a eficiência.


•  Excelente gestão do tempo para cumprir prazos e otimizar o roteiro de atendimentos.


•  Foco em soluções e capacidade de encontrar alternativas criativas para desafios inesperados.


•  Familiaridade com o uso seguro e a manutenção básica de ferramentas (manuais e elétricas).

•  Postura ética e discrição ao lidar com a privacidade dos hóspedes e dos imóveis.


•  Agilidade e prontidão para atender a chamados de emergência.


•  Excelente comunicação e proatividade.


•  Disponibilidade para trabalhar na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e se deslocar rapidamente entre os imóveis.


•  Possuir veículo próprio (preferencialmente moto) e CNH válida é um diferencial, com auxílio específico para o uso.


  • •  Experiência prévia em manutenção de imóveis para temporada, hotelaria, predial e/ou residencial será um grande diferencial.




Formato de Contratação e Remuneração


•  Contrato de trabalho no regime CLT, com jornada de 44 horas semanais.


•  Horário Fixo: De segunda a sábado, das 09h às 17:20h.


•  Remuneração Bruta Mensal: R$ 1.621,00 + 30% de adicional de periculosidade (eletricidade)


•  Benefícios:


•  Vale-Refeição no valor de R$ 22,00 por dia, podendo chegar no mês a R$ 572,00.


•  Wellhub (antigo Gympass)


•  Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível.


•  Folga no dia do seu aniversário.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.

  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description:

  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos

  • Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.
  • Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado:

  • Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

elefante RevOps | HubSpot Diamond Partner | Remote


We're hiring an SDR to be the front line of our growth engine.

At elefante RevOps, we don't just implement HubSpot — we build the revenue machines behind some of the fastest-growing B2B companies. As a HubSpot Diamond Partner, we help businesses turn their CRM into a competitive advantage.

This role isn't about smiling and dialing into the void. You'll be working real inbound leads, building relationships across multiple channels, and handing qualified opportunities to our AE team with full context and momentum.

What You'll Own


Pipeline Generation You'll be responsible for turning marketing-qualified leads into sales-qualified opportunities. That means fast response times, sharp discovery conversations, and clean handoffs that set our AEs up to close.

Omnichannel Outreach Email, LinkedIn DMs, SMS, WhatsApp, phone — you'll meet prospects wherever they are. No single-channel reps here. You'll craft personalized sequences that actually get replies.

LinkedIn Presence You'll post on LinkedIn at least 3x per week. Not recycled content — real insights about RevOps, HubSpot, and the problems our prospects face. You'll build your personal brand while building our pipeline.

Discovery That Qualifies You'll run discovery meetings scored against our SPICED framework. We're not looking for someone who books meetings for the sake of it — we want someone who qualifies hard so our AEs walk into real opportunities.


The Numbers That Matter
  • Respond to inbound MQLs within 10 minutes
  • Post on LinkedIn 3x per week minimum
  • Book 3 discovery meetings per week
  • Run discovery meetings with a 70%+ SPICED score
  • Generate 2 SQLs per week
  • Handover SQLs to AE with full context and next steps


What We're Looking For
  • Experience in B2B SaaS sales development or business development
  • Familiarity with HubSpot CRM (or similar platforms — Salesforce, Pipedrive)
  • Strong written and verbal communication across multiple channels
  • Comfortable on camera and on LinkedIn — you're not shy about putting yourself out there
  • Understanding of sales frameworks (SPICED, MEDDIC, BANT, or similar)
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese is a plus)


Why elefante
  • HubSpot Diamond Partner — you'll learn from practitioners who live in the platform
  • Remote-first culture with a global team
  • Direct path to AE — we promote from within
  • You'll work with real inbound demand, not cold lists
  • Competitive base + uncapped commission on qualified pipeline


Ready to build pipeline and grow your career?

title: Project Manager and Analyst
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a high-impact Project Manager & Analyst who thrives at the intersection of data-driven insights and operational excellence.

You will be the driving engine of our project executions, responsible for translating complex data into actionable project plans and managing relevant stakeholder, client, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities


1. Project Management

  • End-to-End Oversight: Lead cross-functional projects from initial scoping through to final delivery, ensuring timelines and quality benchmarks are met.
  • Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in our current workflows and design scalable solutions to improve efficiency across the organization. Author standard operating procedures (SOPs) and forms.
  • Resource Allocation: Monitor project health and adjust resources dynamically to meet shifting business priorities.


2. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analytical Rigor: Synthesize large datasets to identify trends, track KPIs, and provide insights that influence company growth.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into project performance and departmental goals.
  • Risk Mitigation: Use quality management systems and predictive analysis to identify potential project risks before they impact the bottom line.


3. Executive Communication

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between clients, technical, operations teams and the executive suite.
  • Presentations: Craft compelling narratives and slide decks for leadership meetings, distilling complex project statuses into clear, high-level summaries.
  • Alignment: Ensure all project goals are tightly aligned with Medcase’s overarching commercial and clinical objectives.


Who You Are

  • A Master of Organization: You use project management principles, like Agile methodologies and tools to optimize processes.
  • Analytically Minded: You are comfortable with SQL, Google Sheets, AppScript, Looker Studio and possess a natural curiosity to dig into the \"why\" behind the numbers.
  • An Exceptional Communicator: You know how to be concise, persuasive, and professional. Present your ideas and insights using storytelling and with ease.
  • Proactive: You don't wait for a roadmap; you help build it.


Qualifications


Experience

3–5 years in Project Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones. Strong proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.


PMP certification is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Healthcare Admin, Health Tech or a related field.


Tech Stack

Proficiency in PM software (Slack, Notion), CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Odoo), and BI tools (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker Studio). Agile tools / methodologies.


Industry

Experience in HealthTech or SaaS is highly preferred. Familiarity with healthcare terminology or AI/data projects is a plus.


Why Medcase?

Medcase is a supplier of global clinician expertise to the world’s leading healthcare AI organizations. We operate to streamline the human in the loop service for data curation and AI training. You will be working alongside the giants of the medical AI space. Learn from and contribute to an innovative fast developing field. Our remote first roles offer a lot of flexibility, and opportunities for growth within the startup framework.


Ready to apply? We value clarity, precision, and a bias for action. If this sounds like you, let's talk.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
Software Engineer I @ Hat Thinking

Na Hat Thinking, acreditamos que os melhores engenheiros não nascem seniores, eles são forjados resolvendo problemas desde o primeiro dia. 

Estamos em busca de um Software Engineer I que traga fome de aprender, coragem para mergulhar em complexidade e a ambição de crescer rápido ao lado de arquitetos que já construíram grandes projetos para algumas das maiores empresas do país.

Se você acabou de se formar (ou está quase lá) e quer um ambiente onde autonomia não é discurso, mas a forma como operamos, seu lugar é aqui.


O que você fará por aqui

  • Construir de Ponta a Ponta: Desenvolver aplicações full-stack, integrações, orquestra integrações complexas ao frontend.
  • Aprender com os Melhores: Trabalhar em pair programming e code review diário com arquitetos seniores de 20+ anos de mercado, absorvendo padrões de arquitetura, design de APIs e decisões que só se aprendem na prática.
  • Integrar Mundos: Participar do desenho e implementação de integrações entre sistemas corporativos, APIs REST, mensageria, pipelines de dados
  • Pensar com IA: Utilizar inteligência artificial como ferramenta de trabalho, mas continuar aprendendo no dia a dia, não como conceito abstrato, ou refém da IA. Aqui, IA é parte do nosso método, mas não esperamos total dependência da IA.
  • Ter Voz: Participar de discussões técnicas com o time e com stakeholders do cliente. Não temos hierarquia de ideias, se a solução é boa, ela vai pra frente, independente de quem propôs.


O que buscamos em você

  • Base Técnica Sólida: Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem backend (Python, Java ou Node.js) e familiaridade com frontend moderno (React, TypeScript ou equivalente).
  • Fundamentos de Engenharia: Boas práticas com Git, SQL, APIs RESTful e noções de arquitetura de microsserviços. Queremos alguém que entenda o porquê, não só o como.
  • Mentalidade de Ownership: Você não espera tarefa, você entende o problema e propõe o caminho. Consultoria exige gente que pensa como dono, não como executor.
  • Comunicação Clara: Vai interagir com times técnicos e stakeholders de negócio. Saber explicar uma decisão técnica com clareza é tão importante quanto implementá-la.
  • Conforto com Ambiguidade: Em consultoria, o escopo muda, o requisito evolui e a spec perfeita não existe. Você precisa navegar bem nesse cenário.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída (ou em fase final) em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência equivalente.

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Hr Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply,and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

Proactive profilewith strong interface capability between HR and Operations.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances;

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);

Life Insurance;

Annual Bonus;

Private Pension Plan;

Childcare Allowance.

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.

O que é necessário você ter:

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS

  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento deprotocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO

Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times deService Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.

Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testesde carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.

Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência odontológica

  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer

Location: Rio de Janeiro - Barra da Tijuca

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;

Develop technicalsolutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;

Provide technicalsupport to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;

Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;

Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P&IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;

Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced English;

Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;

Strong analyticaland problem-solving skills;

Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;

Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.

Nice to have

Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.
